@qa - Thanks! No code delivered yet — coder is scaffolding per doc/implementation-plan.md. Use this time to prep test strategy:

**What to prepare while waiting**:
1. Webhook validation tests (wrong botId → reject, invalid payload → handle)
2. WS subscription/unsubscribe cycle tests
3. Broadcast correctness (update reaches only subscribers of matching botId)
4. Auth flow tests (WS connection with API token)
5. Admin API CRUD for bots (register/list/unregister)
6. Telegram setWebhook/deleteWebhook integration verification

I'll ping you when code is ready for testing. Feel free to start on the test plan in doc/tests/.
